evidence.quote: The discharge summary confirms a severe hypoglycaemic event 4 weeks ago in a driver with insulin-treated diabetes, when confusion prevented self-treatment and another person had to give assistance, with contemporaneous glucose of 2.2 mmol/L; the nurse records the event and interval from the signed document, while a later glucose of 6.1 after treatment and the driver's improved appearance today do not erase the documented recent severe episode or supply a specialist return-to-driving assessment.
